correctness.rationale: For 0<q<=1, the equality <khat_u,khat_v>=q is a real positive constraint, not modulus-only; its solutions give v=s_±(r)e^{iθ} with s_±=(r±sqrt(1-q²))/(1±r sqrt(1-q²)). For C_c rank one, align u with c, choose minus branch, and maximize F=q(1-r²)/((1-kr)(1-ar)). The exact identity 2(1-kr)(1-ar)-(1-ak+qb)(1-r²)=[((1+ak+qb)r-(a+k))²]/(1+ak+qb) proves the sharp value and equality at r=(a+k)/(1+ak+qb) in [0,1). The c=0 circular family and q=1 branch merging are explicitly treated, as are norm ||C_c||=1/b, saturation q=b, chordal defect and half-open global range. Independently tested the overlap real phase, perfect square and witnesses on seven parameter pairs plus 3,507 bounded grid points. This is a proof for all real parameters, with bounded numerical testing supplementary.
residual_risks: No assertion for q=0 or complex overlap phase; equality classification depends on the stated positive-real constraint.
